title: Short title, extent and commencement
legal_text: Short title: the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011. Came into force 1 April 2011.

title: Definition: 'Consumer'
legal_text: Has the meaning assigned in clause (7) of section 2 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 (originally clause (d), sub-section 1, section 2 of the Consumer Protection Act, 1986).

title: Definition: 'institutional consumer'
legal_text: The institution which buys packaged commodities bearing a declaration 'not for retail sale', directly from the manufacturer/importer/wholesale dealer for use by that institution and not for commercial or trade purposes.

title: Definition: 'E-commerce'
legal_text: Buying and selling of goods and services including digital products over digital and electronic network.

title: Definition: 'E-commerce entity'
legal_text: A company incorporated under the Companies Act 1956/2013 or a foreign company / branch / agency in India conducting e-commerce business.

title: Definition: 'marketplace based model of e-commerce'
legal_text: Provision of an information-technology platform by an e-commerce entity on a digital/electronic network to act as a facilitator between buyer and seller.

title: Definition: 'retail sale price'
legal_text: The maximum price at which the commodity in packaged form may be sold to the consumer, inclusive of all taxes.

title: Definition: 'combination package'
legal_text: A package intended for retail sale containing two or more individual packages/pieces of dissimilar commodities (e.g. spoons+knives+forks+cups+napkins together).

title: Definition: 'group package'
legal_text: A package intended for retail sale containing two or more individual packages/pieces of similar but not identical commodities (differing in weight/measure/volume/appearance/quality) - e.g. assorted sponges of different sizes, or assorted biscuits.

title: Definition clause (h) - medical devices proviso
legal_text: Proviso: for packages containing medical devices, the Medical Devices Rules, 2017 apply to make declarations (instead of / in addition to this clause).

title: Application of Chapter (exclusions)
legal_text: The provisions of this Chapter shall not apply to: (a) packages of commodities containing quantity of more than 25 kilogram or 25 litre; (b) cement, fertilizer and agricultural farm produce sold in bags above 50 kilogram; and (c) packaged commodities meant for industrial consumers or institutional consumers.

title: Application (grouped promotional packages, renumbered)
legal_text: Renumbered as sub-rule (1) by AMD-2021-779; original single-paragraph rule 4 content not captured verbatim in this pass.

title: Grouped/promotional packages must each comply with Rule 6
legal_text: When one or more packages intended for retail sale are grouped together for being sold as a retail package on promotional offer, every package of the group shall comply with the provisions of rule 6.

title: Bonded-warehouse (AEO Tier-2/3) declaration timing
legal_text: For removal of doubt, importers may make mandatory declarations at bonded warehouses of Authorised Economic Operator Tier-2/Tier-3 certified operators in India, PROVIDED all mandatory declarations under these rules are complete before the retail packages leave that bonded warehouse.

title: [OMITTED]
legal_text: Rule 5 was omitted in its entirety.

title: Declarations to be made on every package
legal_text: Every pre-packaged commodity must carry a defined set of mandatory declarations; the specific sub-clauses are modelled individually below (6(1)(a)/(aa)/(b)/(c)/(d)/(da)/(e), 6(4A), 6(10), 6(10A), 6(11)).

title: Name & address of manufacturer/packer/importer
legal_text: Name and address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of the manufacturer and packer, or name and address of the importer. Explanation III: for food articles, this clause does not apply - instead the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and rules thereunder apply. A proviso (2022, electronics only, 1-year transitional window from 15-Jul-2022) allowed a QR-code alternative to printing this on-package.

title: Country of origin / manufacture / assembly
legal_text: The name of the country of origin, manufacture, or assembly (in the case of imported products) shall be mentioned on the package.

title: Common or generic name of the commodity
legal_text: The common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package. A proviso (2022, electronics only, transitional) allowed a QR-code alternative to printing this on-package.

title: Net quantity
legal_text: The net quantity, in terms of standard units of weight, measure, or number, of the commodity contained in the package.

title: Month and year of manufacture/pack/import
legal_text: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured, or pre-packed, or imported, shall be mentioned on the package (2021 amendment removed the words 'or pre-packed or imported' from this clause's qualifying text - net effect: verify exact current wording against principal rules before treating as VERIFIED).

title: Best-before / use-by date
legal_text: If a package contains a commodity which may become unfit for human consumption after a period of time, the 'best before or use by the date, month and year' shall also be mentioned on the label (does not apply if another law already provides for this).

title: Retail Sale Price (MRP)
legal_text: The retail sale price of the package shall clearly indicate that it is the maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes, in Indian currency, and the price in rupees and paise shall be rounded off to the nearest rupee or 50 paise. Exceptions: alcoholic beverages/spirituous liquor follow applicable State Excise law where that law itself provides for a retail-price declaration; and any essential commodity whose price is fixed/notified by a competent authority under the Essential Commodities Act, 1955 follows that notified price instead.

title: Voluntary additional declarations permitted
legal_text: Nothing in this rule precludes a manufacturer/packer/importer from ALSO declaring, in addition to the mandatory declarations: (a) Barcode/GTIN/QR Code; (b) an 'e-code' for net-quantity assurance (after obtaining it as specified by the Central Government); (c) logos of Government schemes such as Swachh Bharat Mission, where authorised.

title: E-commerce entities must display mandatory declarations
legal_text: An e-commerce entity shall ensure the mandatory declarations under sub-rule (1) - except the month/year of manufacture - are displayed on the digital/electronic network used for the e-commerce transaction. In a marketplace model, responsibility for correctness of the declarations lies with the manufacturer/seller/dealer/importer (not the platform) if the platform is a passive intermediary under IT Act, 2000 due-diligence standards; this safe harbour is lost if the platform conspired/abetted the unlawful act, or failed to act on actual notice. This does not exempt anyone from making the required declarations on physical packages delivered to consumers.

title: E-commerce country-of-origin searchable/sortable filter (imported products)
legal_text: Every e-commerce entity offering for sale any imported product shall ensure the product listing of such imported product contains a searchable and sortable filter specifying the country of origin.

title: Unit sale price declaration
legal_text: The unit sale price in rupees, rounded off to the nearest two decimal places, shall be declared on every pre-packaged commodity as follows: (i) per gram if net quantity < 1 kg, per kilogram if >= 1 kg; (ii) per centimetre if net length < 1 m, per metre if >= 1 m; (iii) per millilitre if net volume < 1 litre, per litre if >= 1 litre; (iv) per number/unit if sold by number or unit. Alcoholic beverages/spirituous liquor follow applicable State Excise law within the manufacturing State.

title: Manner in which declarations are to be made
Minimum height of numerals/letters (Table-I)
legal_text: The height of any numeral and letter in a required declaration shall be at least the minimum specified in Table-I, keyed to the area (in cm^2) of the package's Principal Display Panel. A 2025 proviso disapplies this in favour of the Medical Devices Rules, 2017 for medical-device packages.

title: Minimum width of numerals/letters
legal_text: The width of the letter or numeral shall not be less than one-third of its height, except for the numeral '1' and letters such as 'i', 'I', 'l'. A 2025 proviso disapplies this in favour of the Medical Devices Rules, 2017 for medical-device packages.

title: Declaration for items sold by number
legal_text: For items sold by number, the number, unit, piece, pair, set, or such other word representing the quantity in the package shall be mentioned.

title: Wholesale package - Consumer Protection Act cross-references
legal_text: Cross-references clauses (41) and (47) of section 2 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 (updated from the corresponding 1986-Act clauses).

title: Wholesale package - tax terminology (GST)
legal_text: References 'Goods and Service Tax' (updated from the pre-GST terms 'Value Added Tax (VAT)' and 'Turnover Tax (TOT)').

title: Exemption in respect of certain packages
legal_text: Nothing in these rules applies to a package containing a commodity if any of the listed clauses (a)-(f) apply; several clauses have since been narrowed by amendment (see child rows).

title: Exemption clause (a) - with pan-masala carve-out
legal_text: General exemption clause (a) (exact original wording not captured verbatim this session); a further proviso inserted in 2025 clarifies that the exemption under this clause does NOT apply to pan masala.

title: Exemption clause (c) - Drug Price Control Order formulations
legal_text: Exempts packages containing scheduled and non-scheduled formulations covered under the Drugs (Price Control) Order, 2013 (made under the Essential Commodities Act, 1955); PROVIDED that no exemption applies to medical devices declared as drugs.

title: Exemption clause (f) - loose garments/hosiery
legal_text: Exempts a garment or hosiery commodity sold loose/open at the point of sale (where the consumer can inspect before buying), PROVIDED the product itself bears: (i) name & address of manufacturer/marketer/brand-owner/importer with country of origin/manufacture if imported; (ii) consumer-care email id and phone number; (iii) sizes with internationally recognizable indicators (S/M/L/XL/XXL/XXXL) plus metric cm/m detail; (iv) MRP inclusive of all taxes in Indian currency. Applies only to finished products; must additionally be displayed on the e-commerce listing if sold online; sellers may voluntarily comply before the effective date.

title: Registration must name the responsible Director
legal_text: Registration particulars for a company/firm must include the name of the Director of the company responsible for violations under the Act and rules made thereunder.

title: Annual update of registration details
legal_text: A company/firm shall update its registration details annually, including any change in particulars; an option shall be made available on the online portal for this annual update (address, products, and related particulars).

title: Power to grant relaxation [STUB - needs verification]
legal_text: Renumbered as sub-rule (1) by the 2025 amendment; original text describing what relaxation is granted and under what conditions was not captured verbatim this session. NEEDS_SOURCE_VERIFICATION against SRC-001/relevant earlier amendment.

title: Rule-33 relaxation disapplied for medical devices
legal_text: In case the Medical Devices Rules, 2017 are applicable to a package, the relaxation otherwise given under rule 33 shall NOT apply.
